messages:
Rae (CS): quick heads-up from CumulusRx onboarding: token spend up ~25% week-over-week and sporadic p99 spikes on long clinical summaries. Renewal in ~7w. want low-friction perf options (cost + tail) without changing clinician wording.
Dr. Li (CumulusRx): templates are used for medlists and discharge bullets. Freeform narrative is sensitive 1 accuracy. We can mark template requests from our side if needed.
Evan (Solutions): can you share token length histogram and an example long prompt? helps decide routing rules.
Dr. Li (CumulusRx): token mix: ~62% short, 28% medium, 10% long (>1k). Example long prompt attached to ticket 7122.
Hannah (Eng-ML): recommendation: 1) deploy int8-quant compact for template flows 2) header-based routing: clients add `X-Cumulus-Template` for deterministic routing 3) KV prefix cache for repeated templates 4) shadowing + small canary + automated rollback on quality/latency thresholds. Also add an uncertainty detector to fallback to full model on low confidence.
Kai (SRE): ops note: caching + batching will help tail, but ensure cache TTL meets PHI policy. we need an excludes list for endpoints that go to compliance.
Evan (Solutions): sample canary plan:
```json
{
  "shadow_hours": 48,
  "rollout_steps": [5, 20],
  "compact": "compact-int8-v1",
  "full": "full-v4",
  "route_on_header": "X-Cumulus-Template",
  "excludes": ["/audit/*"]
}
```
Rae (CS): Dr. Li 1 can your team add the header `X-Cumulus-Template: medlist_v1` for server-side template calls?
Dr. Li (CumulusRx): yes, we can. ETA 3 dev days. we'll also flag audited endpoints.
Hannah (Eng-ML): I'll prepare a 60-case golden eval set (medlists + discharge conclusions) and run ROUGE + a small clinician QA checklist comparing compact-int8 vs full. will surface any hallucination risk.
Evan (Solutions): rollout: shadow 48h -> 5% for 6h -> 20% for 24h if stable. alerts on p95/p99 and quality delta. recommend rollback if quality drop >1.5% or p99 >4s.
Kai (SRE): canary-bot, schedule shadow=48h -> staged rollout; enable auto-rollback thresholds.
canary-bot: canary scheduled: shadow=48h -> rollout=5% -> thresholds set. link: https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/3152467890
Rae (CS): action items: 1) Dr. Li to add header + endpoint excludes 2) Hannah to deliver eval harness 3) Evan to finalize canary config 4) Kai to run canary and set alerts 5) Rae to include cost/quality summary in renewal pack.
Dr. Li (CumulusRx): confirmed. thanks team for low-risk plan.
Hannah (Eng-ML): I'll also log uncertainty scores and sample mismatches to private bucket for clinician review.
Rae (CS): will report back after 72h of shadowing with initial metrics. :thumbsup:
